letter:
My Motu,

Happy Birthday, my love.

925 days ago, an ice cream started all of this. I had no idea that one small moment would turn into the best part of my life. Then came that nervous first call on 9th April, and I've been talking to you every single day since.

This year, I counted. Over 12,000 messages, 173 days in a row without missing you once, and good mornings that I never want to stop sending. But no number can explain what you are to me.

I still think about last year's birthday at Virgin Courtyard. The candles, the flowers, and you sitting across from me. I remember thinking that I want to be there for every birthday of yours. And here I am, already planning the next one.

You are my safe place. You laugh at my terrible jokes, you take care of me even when I'm being difficult, and you love me with your whole heart. Your cooking, your patience, the way you say my name, your dream for your career - I want to be there for everything. I'm proud of you every single day.

My Cute Dictator, rule over me forever. I'm not complaining.

Distance has always tried its best, but we win every year anyway. Dharamshala, Shimla, every trip, every call that went on too long. Every bit of it was worth it.

Here's to you, to us, and to every birthday after this one. I can't wait for the day I get to wish you Happy Birthday without a single kilometre between us.

I love you, today and always.

Forever yours,
Your Gappu-loving Motu,
Ankit
finale: Happy Birthday, my love. Here's to many more years, together.
